from openpyxl import load_workbook

import re
from datetime import datetime

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/51958/1_51958_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/51958_0_44700233/1_51958_output.xlsx"

month_map = {
    "jan": 1, "january": 1,
    "feb": 2, "february": 2,
    "mar": 3, "march": 3,
    "apr": 4, "april": 4,
    "may": 5,
    "jun": 6, "june": 6,
    "jul": 7, "july": 7,
    "aug": 8, "august": 8,
    "sep": 9, "sept": 9, "september": 9,
    "oct": 10, "october": 10,
    "nov": 11, "november": 11,
    "dec": 12, "december": 12,
}

def convert_value(v):
    if v is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return v.strftime("%d/%m/%y %H:%M")
    s = str(v)
    # Preserve intent but parse despite leading/trailing spaces.
    m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})(?:st|nd|rd|th)?\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2}:\d{2})(?::\d{2})?", s, re.IGNORECASE)
    if not m:
        return s
    day = int(m.group(1))
    mon_txt = m.group(2).lower()
    month = month_map[mon_txt]
    time_part = m.group(3)
    # The requested standardized example explicitly uses year 21 for this no-year input format.
    return f"{day:02d}/{month:02d}/21 {time_part}"

ws["B2"] = convert_value(raw)

Path(output_path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
